title: embeddings-rerank-debug-breadcrumbs-2026-03-04
content:
Notes / breadcrumbs for embedding + rerank anomalies (dim mismatch + latency spikes)

Summary:
- Started seeing recurring errors in rerank endpoint after yesterday's embedding model rollout (2026-02-27, ~09:00 PST).
- Two distinct symptoms: (1) dimension mismatch errors on a subset of queries; (2) intermittent latency spikes (p95 from ~120ms -> 900-1200ms) correlated with retries/fallbacks.
- Hypothesis: upstream embedding model change (or conversion/quantization step) changed output shape or dropped a component occasionally; rerank code assumes fixed dim (1536).

Timeline / quick breadcrumbs:
- 2026-02-27 08:53 - deploy of models:v2.8 -> embeddings model updated (PR #214).
- 2026-02-27 09:12 - first user error report: rerank returned 500 for some requests.
- 2026-02-27 09:15 - SRE alerted via pager. Initial logs show ValueError: Dimension mismatch (expected 1536, got 1535).
- 2026-02-27 10:00 - rolled traffic to 20% on previous model; errors decreased but not gone.
- 2026-02-28 - reproduced locally with dev container and sample prompts.

Commands I ran (local, dev container):
- curl to embeddings service (checked raw vector length):
  $ curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/embeddings \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"input":"This is a test query to check embedding length"}' | jq -r '.data[0].embedding | length'
  -> 1535 (observed)

- quick python check: (embeddings returned as list)
  >>> vec = requests.post(emb_url, json={"input": text}).json()['data'][0]['embedding']
  >>> len(vec)
  1535

- rerank endpoint (local) stack trace snippet:
  Traceback (most recent call last):
    File "rerank_service.py", line 212, in handle_query
      scores = faiss_index.dot(query_vec)  # expects dim 1536
  ValueError: Dimension mismatch: index dim=1536, query dim=1535

- quick repro harness iterating random prompts (1000 runs): ~0.8% of queries produced 1535-length vectors, rest 1536. Not deterministic per prompt.

Latency notes:
- p50 stable~110ms for rerank path (fast path).
- Intermittent p95 spikes to 900-1200ms; correlates with errors followed by fallback path (recompute, retry).
- Server logs show retries: embedding_service timed out (500ms), then fallback to remote-hosted-embedding causing added latency.
- Trace ids: trace-20260227-09-17-{a few ids} show long tail in embedding call (waiting ~700ms) before returning shorter vector.

Error snippets found in logs:
- "ValueError: Dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1535" (multiple hosts: embed-01, embed-03)
- "WARNING embedding_converter.py: trimmed trailing element during float16->float32 conversion" (suspicious)
- "TimeoutError: embedding model inference exceeded 500ms" immediately prior to some mismatch instances

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Model output changed (shape) in small subset due to tokenization edge-case or off-by-one in pooling layer after PR #214.
2) Post-processing / conversion bug: quantization -> dequantization script (float16 pack/unpack) occasionally drops last element (race or buffer length mismatch). Note: I saw a warning line in embed conversion logs.
3) Partial/streamed response truncated by network proxy (nginx timeout) leading to short payload parsed as valid JSON but missing last float.
4) Upstream batching logic pads arrays into contiguous buffer and an indexing bug occasionally leaves last float uninitialized/omitted.
5) Downstream consumer (rerank) assumes 1536 but accepts 1535 silently in some code paths then faiss fails at dot product.

Quick checks done so far:
- Replayed same prompt 200x against local embed service: got sporadic 1535 outputs -> suggests nondeterministic in model/convert layer (not deterministic tokenization).
- Inspected PR #214 changes: minor pooling/normalization tweak; no obvious shape change but conversion pipeline updated to use new float16 packer.
- Added simple guard in rerank: if len(vec) != EXPECTED_DIM: log full payload and reject early. This reduced noisy crashes but still saw short vectors being emitted.
- Reproduced float packing warning by running conversion binary with --stress option; got logs: "trimmed trailing element" when buffer size % 8 != 0 (suspect alignment/padding bug).

Immediate mitigations suggested / applied:
- Add validation in embedding service: verify len(embedding) == expected_dim before returning; if mismatch -> 500 and log full base64 payload (done on dev host).
- Circuit-breaker: route 100% traffic back to previous embedding model version for hosted customers (rolled to 10% then 0% by 2026-02-27 11:20).
- Add retry/backfill: when rerank receives shorter vector, request again (but this increases latency). Temporary until root cause fixed.

Next steps / TODOs:
- [ ] Instrument the conversion binary with more detailed logging (dump buffer lengths and offsets) -- assigned to Aran.
- [ ] Add checksum on embedding payload (simple ack) to detect truncation at transport layer.
- [ ] Re-run the full repro harness with env VARS: FORCE_FLOAT16=1 and PACKER_DEBUG=1 to reproduce locally (Evan).
- [ ] Check nginx/proxy timeouts & keepalive settings between embed service and conversion container (SRE).
- [ ] Create unit tests in models repo that assert embedding dims across model + conversion steps (Maya).
- [ ] Postmortem draft after full rollback and permanent fix (owner: Evelyn).

Notes / scratch ideas:
- If issue is quantization packer, the symptom matches: buffer alignment -> last float dropped -> length-1. That would be nondeterministic for some input sizes.
- Add a small header field with declared "dim":1536 in API response so consumers can validate without decoding full array (cheap check).
- For latency: ensure rerank retries use exponential backoff and fast fail if embedding service is slow (we currently wait full 500ms then retry once).
- Consider storing a short signature (first 4 floats hashed) and compare between embed and conversion pipeline to see where mismatch originates.

Reproduction notes (commands to run locally):
- Build conversion binary with debug flags: make convert PACKER_DEBUG=1
- Start local embed stack: docker-compose up --build (services: embed-api, embed-converter, rerank-dev)
- Run harness: python tools/repro_harness.py --n 5000 --log-short-vecs --save-raw (will write to /tmp/evan-emb-repro-2026-03-04)

Random observations:
- Affected hosts: embed-01, embed-03 (both on same CUDA driver version); embed-02 hasn't shown error yet (might be different CPU allocator for conversion container).
- Memory pressure on embed-converter around spikes? saw OOM-kill event a week prior after unrelated rollout. Check allocator flags.

Open questions to triage in next sync:
- Is the float packer new in PR #214 or earlier? (I thought it was introduced in PR #212).
- Why are only ~0.8% of requests affected? Is there an input-size/padding correlation?
- Can we replicate with a tiny synthetic vector generation (simulate packer) to prove alignment bug?

If I/O bound time: prioritise: 1) force rollback 2) add server-side validation 3) deeper logging on conversion packer

Scratch \u2014 raw sample payload (anonymized):
{"meta":{"request_id":"trace-20260227-09-17-abc123"}, "data":[{"embedding":"[0.00123, 0.00234, ..., 0.00345]" /* length reported: 1535 */}]}

End notes: will keep updating. Next update after conversion binary instrumentation and reproducer run (Evan).
